judgment.notes: N001 is instantiated with (m,A,exponent)=(n,E,s) under 0<s<D and with (n+1,F,s+1) under s+1>0. N006 applies at the same positive s and the positive witness δ. N002 licenses the finite real interpretation of D. The background order facts have their required positivity, finiteness and supremum grounds.

S001 obtains infinite H^s(E) and a scale exceeding any prescribed finite threshold. S002 transfers this bound by N006 and the defining supremum, proving H^(s+1)(F)=∞. N001 then gives dim_H(F)≥s+1 for all 0<s<D; positivity and finiteness of D justify the endpoint bound D+1. The additional scale-monotonicity statement in S001 is also valid: decreasing δ restricts admissible covers, so their infimum cannot decrease. It is not needed for S002.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
